verdict.rationale: Penpot's self-hosting model and privacy stance ('Keep your data private. Penpot will never make business out of your data. Choose where and how to host it') implies users can avoid vendor-side telemetry by running their own instance, and the MCP server is also self-hostable with no cloud dependency. However, there is no explicit documentation of an in-app telemetry/usage-tracking toggle or opt-out setting for the cloud-hosted version. Missing for 10: explicit telemetry/analytics opt-out control documentation, confirmation that self-hosted instances don't phone home any usage data, and any settings UI for disabling tracking.
